provenance.sourceText: Seule une plateforme agréée est habilitée à assurer toutes les fonctionnalités prévues.

facts.notes: Reused AS-IS from the citation already sourced at the git landmark `avant-refonte-documents` (compliance/profiles/data/fr.ts, note 'FR-D1' on transmission): 'From 2026-09-01 the emission, transmission and reception of an in-scope invoice go through an accredited platform — "Seule une plateforme agréée est habilitée à assurer toutes les fonctionnalités prévues" (impots.gouv.fr, consulted 2026-08-27). Sending such an invoice by e-mail is not a lesser channel, it is a sanctioned one: CGI art.1737 III, 50 EUR per invoice capped at 15 000 EUR a year, and IV bis, 500 EUR then 1 000 EUR per quarter for persisting in not using an accredited platform.' That same landmark sourced the effective date itself (2026-09-01) to CGI art. 289 bis/290 (Légifrance, consulted 2026-08-28) — see also country-policy/data/fr.json's own 'invoice.download-xml' note, which already addresses this same question of mandatory character. This file therefore settles this mandatory character HERE, with the citation the landmark already carried, without adding a new one that would not have been verified.
